content:
Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading specialty chemical company based in the Minhang District of Shanghai, China. Established with a strong commitment to innovation, quality, and sustainability, the company has grown to become a trusted partner for clients across diverse industries, including pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, electronics, new energy materials, and fine chemicals. Strategically located in one of China’s most dynamic industrial and technological hubs, Meryer leverages Shanghai’s robust infrastructure, logistics networks, and access to talent to deliver high-performance chemical solutions both domestically and internationally.

The company specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of a wide range of chemical products, from standard reagents to custom-synthesized intermediates and advanced functional materials. Meryer places great emphasis on rigorous quality control, adhering to international standards such as ISO certifications and complying with REACH, RoHS, and other global regulatory frameworks. With a customer-centric approach, the company offers tailored services, including technical support, small- to large-scale production, and rapid delivery, ensuring responsiveness to evolving market demands.

Driven by a vision of scientific excellence and sustainable development, Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. continuously invests in R&D and green chemistry initiatives, aiming to minimize environmental impact while maximizing product efficacy. As a forward-looking enterprise, Meryer remains dedicated to fostering long-term partnerships and contributing to the advancement of the global chemical industry through innovation and integrity.
